ENGINE – ENGINE MECHANICAL

Fuel Inlet Hose
P11643

13. DISCONNECT FUEL HOSES
(a) Remove the union bolt and 2 gaskets, disconnect the fuel inlet hose.
HINT:
• Put a suitable container or shop rag under the fuel pipe support.
• Slowly loosen the union bolt.
(b) Suspend the hose union end upward.

Fuel Return Hose
P11542

(c) Disconnect the fuel return hose from the oil dipstick guide.
(d) Disconnect the fuel return hose from the fuel return hose. Plug the hose end.

14. REMOVE ENGINE WIRE BRACKET
Remove the bolt and bracket, and disconnect the engine wire from the intake manifold stay.

P12135

15. DISCONNECT PS PUMP WITHOUT DISCONNECTING HOSES
(a) Remove the 3 bolts, plate washer and pump front bracket.

(1)
(2)
P12126

(b) Disconnect these hoses:
(1) Air hose from No.4 timing belt cover
(2) Air hose from air intake chamber
(c) Disconnect the pump housing from the pump bracket.
HINT: Put aside the pump housing, and suspend it.
(d) Remove the 2 bolts and pump rear stay.

P11527

(e) Remove the 2 bolts and pump bracket.
